_comment: Bindings for workflows/qwen_angles_api.json (Comfy Cloud template 'Qwen 1 Click Multiple Character Angles'). One input image feeds 8 angle branches (close-up, 2x wide, 2x aerial, low angle, 90 left, 45 left); each branch has its own KSampler seed. Leave seeds at template defaults unless you pass --set seed=N.
